# Facebook Search Scraper

The Apify actor [`danek/facebook-search-ppr`](https://apify.com/danek/facebook-search-ppr) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **1.7.30**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrap Facebook search results fast and easy. It is designed to be fast and efficient, so it can extract a large number of results for low price. It is also less likely to be blocked by Facebook.

## Pricing

Pay per event — result $0.005, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/danek/facebook-search-ppr) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/danek-facebook-search-ppr@1.7.30#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      query: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes |  | search query — Facebook urls. Can be page or profile |
| `search_type` | string | yes |  | Search type — Which types of results search for |
| `max_posts` | integer | yes |  | max results — Max results to scrape |
| `recent_posts` | boolean |  |  | Recent post — Recent post |
| `location` | string |  |  | Location — Location. For better result include both city and country |
| `start_date` | string |  |  | Date from — Date from which to scrape posts |
| `end_date` | string |  |  | Date to — Date to which to scrape posts |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
